name: waiver-realism-v4
responds_to: laptop-2 suite semantics (test_v6_c02_remote_adversarial.py): limit=0 with proactive_limit=1 must still permit one upside claim, while limit=1 with proactive_limit=1 must permit ONE total claim
supersedes: waiver-realism-v2/v3 budget wording (append-only: v1-v3 preserved byte-for-byte; only the budget FORMULA below replaces v2's 'waiver_moves_per_week IS the budget' sentence, which those reviewer semantics contradict)

weekly_move_budget_formula.total: per-team weekly claims (all types combined) <= max(waiver_moves_per_week, proactive_moves_per_week)
weekly_move_budget_formula.per_type: emergency claims <= waiver_moves_per_week; upside claims <= proactive_moves_per_week
weekly_move_budget_formula.order: emergency claims draw from the shared allowance first; upside claims may use only the remainder
weekly_move_budget_formula.boundary: defaults (1, 1) give a total budget of 1: an executed emergency claim consumes it and a same-week upside claim must not execute; (0, 1) disables emergencies while permitting one upside claim; (2, 1) permits an emergency and an upside claim in the same week
weekly_move_budget_formula.season_cap: season_moves_cap remains a separate additional bound on all claim types

unchanged: everything else in v1-v3, including v3's roster-wide drop feasibility, cost gates and units, counters, seeds, accounting, and the cost/proxy reconciliation
